panels.description:
`Uptime:` This represents the total uptime of the node, formatted as duration (d hh:mm:ss)

`Fan Status:` If there are chasis fans failure then it shows `Check Fans` else `OK`

`Power Status:` If there are Power supply unit failures then it shows `Check Power` else `OK`

`Healthy:` If Node is not healthy then it shows `No` else `Yes`.

panels.description: System utilization as a percentage of total time. CPU Busy is overall processor utilization, Kahuna is the storage OS domain, Max Node Disk Utilization is the busiest disk, and WAFL Write Cleaning is CP write-allocation overhead scaled to total time so it is directly comparable with the other metrics on this panel. For unscaled CP-level detail, see the CP Write Health panel.

options.content:
The APIs for this panel are only available via ZapiPerf. Enable the ZapiPerf collector in your `harvest.yml` config.
See https://github.com/NetApp/harvest/wiki/Troubleshooting-Harvest#why-do-i-have-rewind-view-panels-empty-in-node-dashboard for more details.
